notes: walter-context-preflight (:8897) prepares context before a model call; when it is down nothing is injected (ghost mode), it restarts safely.

A degraded plan (decision.degraded, bus event context.degraded, counted by walter-context-preflight --report) means the Router's decision chain failed, not the preflight: the turn is still served with a prudent L3 pack that says so. Do not restart the preflight for it with restart_unit; check walter-router health and the OpenRouter balance, tell the owner only if the rate stays high.

preflight:degraded (watchdog: >= 2 degraded plans and >= 30 % of the plans of the last 30 min) has one exception: the preflight process may run library code older than the code on disk (2026-11-11: credentials moved, fixed code on disk, old code in RAM, 4 h of degraded plans). The only repair is restart_if_stale (walter deploy restart walter-context-preflight --require-stale): it restarts only when the service is stale (evidence service_stale: true) and the deploy repair is switched on, at most once per hour; rc 3 = fresh or repair off, a restart cannot help: answer needs_owner if the Router/provider cause persists.

restart_if_stale.describe: restart the preflight only if it runs code older than the code on disk (gated: once per hour, deploy repair switch)
